extractions.value: Patient had elevated ANA and anti-SSA/SSB titers but no clinical features of systemic lupus erythematosus or Sjogren syndrome. Patient had hypertension, benign prostatic hypertrophy, and a history of smoking. The anti-GAD titre remained persistently elevated (>250 IU/mL by ELISA) despite clinical improvement after rituximab.
extractions.quote: Although he had elevated ANA and SSA antibody titers, he had no other clinical features of systemic lupus erythematosus, Sjogren syndrome, or any other connective tissue disease. ... the anti-GAD level of our patient remained more than the reportable value (>250 IU/mL), and in spite of these elevated titers, the patient continued to improve clinically.
